scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w MedConnect"
scripts.test: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run test -w MedConnect" "npm run test -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w MedConnect && npm run build -w backend
